title: Cervical cancer colposcopy result ValueSet Schema
description: JSON Schema for Cervical cancer colposcopy result ValueSet ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions using IRI format.
narrative: This schema validates IRI-formatted codes for the Cervical cancer colposcopy result ValueSet ValueSet. Display values are available at http://smart.who.int/hiv/ValueSet-HIV.D.DE691.displays.json. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
